brief:
Abdel Nasser Al-Aghrami, head of the Gaza Bakers Association, warned of worsening flour and bread shortages as the territory faces a deficit exceeding 25 percent of daily flour needs, Shehab Wire reported. International aid has declined while bakeries lack supplies and maintenance materials required for operations.

The shortage threatens to disrupt bread production and leave residents without adequate supplies, Al-Aghrami said. Gaza's bakeries are struggling to meet civilian demand amid the combined pressures of reduced humanitarian assistance and operational constraints.

title: Gaza bakery chief warns flour shortage threatens bread production
